verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an API for retrieving payout or balance-transaction data, or for reconciling a bank deposit to its underlying charges. The reporting evidence describes only a visual representation of balances and payouts, and payout-frequency settings are configuration, not data retrieval. The documented MCP tools cover checkout sessions, payment links, modifications and Management API resources, with no payout, settlement or reporting tools.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges
